title: The Lost Grimoire
description: The grimoire belonged to Edric Vayle, Helvant's own master, and it is most of what Helvant knows that he didn't teach himself. He hasn't set foot in Willow Dale in decades - not since the undead there, first grief and now simply age. This isn't a guild sending an Adept after guild property. It's an old man asking a near-stranger to go get back the one thing he has left of the person who taught him.

objectives.description: Travel to the ruins where the grimoire has lain for decades
Find the library chamber, past whatever traps still hold
objectives.notes: Deep in Willow Dale dungeon, past magical traps

objectives.description: Put down whatever's been guarding it all this time
objectives.notes: Summoned elemental or construct guarding the tome

objectives.description: Take Edric Vayle's grimoire - carefully, it's the only copy
objectives.notes: Quest item - cannot be sold or dropped

spawn_on_accept.notes: Magical construct guarding the grimoire chamber
Only spawns after guardian is defeated

notes: Threat: decades of guardians and undead in Willow Dale, faced by a single student with no institution backing them - contrast mage_06's parallel Circle quest to the same kind of ruin, sent by committee instead of grief. Giver motive: personal - Edric Vayle was Helvant's own teacher, and this is the last thing of his left to recover, not guild property. Consequence: flows directly into wizard_stolen_pages, already storied - the pages are found missing the moment the grimoire is opened. Fourth quest in the chain.
